name: Düsseldorf Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways: main (south) runway 3,000 m and north runway 2,700 m
runway.quote: die 3.000 Meter langen, südlich gelegenen Hauptbahn

curfew.v: jets on the Chapter 3 bonus list may depart 06:00-22:00 and land 06:00-23:00 local; delayed landings until 23:30 without exemption; anything else needs an individual exemption from the air supervision office (Bezirksregierung Düsseldorf), granted very restrictively; propeller aircraft up to 9 t with a noise certificate may operate around the clock
curfew.quote: Verspätete Landungen dieser Flugzeuge sind ohne gesonderte Ausnahmegenehmigung bis 23:30 Uhr möglich.

slots.v: coordinated airport with hourly limits on coordinated movements
slots.quote: Anzahl koordinierter Flugbewegungen pro Stunde: 43 oder 45/47

hours.v: General Aviation Terminal (Executive Terminal) open daily 05:30-23:00

handling.v: the General Aviation Terminal is run by Jet Aviation, which also does aircraft guidance and fuelling; the terminal has security and passport control
handling.quote: Die komplette Verantwortung für den Betrieb

notes: DFS AIP not read. Facts from the operator's pages (no page dates): operating hours/night rules, runway system and general aviation. Night window recorded from the jet departure limit (22:00); jet landings run to 23:00 (23:30 if delayed). Home-based airlines have extra allowances not relevant to charter. The GAT has passport control, but customs hours were not found in an official source. A Bundespolizei leaflet (1 Jun 2025) on non-EU arrivals is linked on the GA page but was not read.
